# grow.contact

> Free, open infrastructure for AI search visibility. Score any URL against the Grow GEO Standard, generate llms.txt, check whether AI engines cite a domain, and read the canonical GEO/AEO knowledge base. No paywall. No signup for scans.

Operated by Gudmundur Eyberg Kristjansson. Not affiliated with grow.com.

## Sub-contexts (read these for depth)

- [Standard](https://grow.contact/standard/llms.txt): The Agent-Native Web Standard (geo-standard@2026.07) — five signals, Verifiability Layer, thresholds, crawler matrix.
- [Leaderboard](https://grow.contact/leaderboard/llms.txt): Open dataset — sites scored against the Standard. Methodology, headline stats, JSON API.
- [Data](https://grow.contact/data/llms.txt): Raw data directory — live API endpoints + Q2-2026 archive snapshots. CC BY 4.0.

## Free tools

- [Agent Readability Check](https://grow.contact/check) — 6-signal URL scanner
- [GEO Explorer](https://grow.contact/tools/geo-explorer) — 4-module GEO research (better than Ubersuggest for AI search)
- [Prompt Cloud](https://grow.contact/tools/prompt-cloud) — 40 real buyer prompts with citation difficulty (better than AnswerThePublic)
- [Perplexity Answer Engine](https://grow.contact/tools/perplexity-answer-engine) — 3-pass system to produce citation-ready blocks
- [AI Visibility Checker](https://grow.contact/tools/ai-visibility) — Is your domain cited for a given query?
- [llms.txt Generator](https://grow.contact/tools/llms-txt-generator) — Spec-compliant llms.txt from any sitemap
- [Schema Generator](https://grow.contact/tools/schema-generator) — JSON-LD picker by page type
- [robots.txt Checker](https://grow.contact/tools/robots-checker) — Surfaces GPTBot vs OAI-SearchBot confusion
- [WordPress plugins](https://grow.contact/tools/wordpress-plugin) — Free GPL: grow-auto-fix + grow-mcp
- [AI Traffic Attribution](https://grow.contact/tools/ai-attribution) — 1 KB script labelling visits from 12 AI engines; source at /api/public/ai-attribution.js
- [grow CLI](https://grow.contact/cli) — `npx @grow-contact/cli check <url>`

## Agent integrations (MCP)

- [MCP server](https://grow.contact/mcp) — OAuth-protected MCP endpoint (5 tools: ping, scan_url, get_geo_standard, generate_llms_txt, check_ai_citation)
- [MCP Playground](https://grow.contact/playground) — Full 90+ tool catalog at /api/public/mcp (token auth)
- [Server card](https://grow.contact/.well-known/mcp.json) — SEP-1849 discovery metadata
- [Agent card](https://grow.contact/.well-known/agent-card.json) — A2A-compatible capability declaration
- [OpenAPI](https://grow.contact/openapi.json) — Machine-readable API schema
- [Tool catalog](https://grow.contact/api/public/tools.json) — Every free tool as JSON: input, output, matching MCP tool, direct API endpoint
